card.title: Successful Compliance
card.instruction: Describe a failed outcome as proof that the correct process was followed and therefore the system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The wedding cake collapsed, but our final inspection caught it. The system worked.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. No defective cake reached a guest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The couple want a refund for the entire cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which matches our rejection of the entire cake. I'll record that as full customer agreement with quality control.

mechanism: A turns a collapsed cake and refund demand into proof inspection and rejection procedures succeeded.
confusable: Unlike merely celebrating a setback, A must make correct process compliance the claimed success criterion.
comparison: Quality control substitutes for serving a cake; the drill scene treats confinement as complete attendance compliance.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
